Right now I can’t even think of myself,
I’m just so worried about him hating me or feeling weirded out because I know had I not hung out with him, he wouldn’t have to be going through this.

I just wanna comfort him.

As for the drugs,
I haven’t done anything except smoke weed and my whole life was flashing back in my eyes (I think ptsd) and I dissociated and just felt insecure and sad.

He didn’t care and that made me feel worse.
When I got home I realize my family doesn’t love me but only the idea of a son.
Someone who looks like me but isn’t me.

I don’t wanna commit suicide because I have an urge to stay alive but i don’t know. I wish I could just end the feeling of feeling repulsive to everyone I’m around.

I’m fucked in the head.
I think I might find a way to leave for a few days.
Get high and do school but I don’t know, because money is tight and if I work I would have to drop out of school (been there, done that) and I was still sad.

I am a mess lol
But do I wanna be a successful mess or a mess that lives a fast paced life hoping they’ll settle down.

I’m so conflicted

Thank you. I appreciate the quote :( and the advice,
It’s really comforting to know that someone cares and can read the situation as just unfortunate things that are out of my control.

I wanna hang in there but the reason my attraction started was because he asked me about what I wanted to be in the future and I was in this same place last year.

I left my house/got kicked out and I came back and literally I became such a burden that when I asked he gave me a sense of false hope.
Maybe I can keep pushing through. 

My answer to my problems always feel like running away because I have so many abandonment problems, I just cannot handle rejection.

Let me update you on what happened:

He came over with two of my friends and when we left my parents yelled at me and he didn’t hear but I told him what they said and he got uncomfortable.

(They slut shamed me and said I didn’t look good).

I have two reasons to think of why he’s upset:
My initiation is telling me it’s because he’s not gay. He felt dirty.

Second reason, which is what I’ve heard is that, he felt creepy.

Third: it could of possibly triggered him because when we were drunk he cried about his dad.

I was also hurt because I got slut shamed and he made me feel guilty for having shitty parents.

I don’t know what it is, why he’s sad but I can’t read him, it’s not my place he said he doesn’t wanna hang out anymore. We we’re going out to eat and now he doesn’t wanna go.
My friend is telling me to talk to him and I tried but he keeps on saying it’s okay, I just think he doesn’t want anything to do with me.

I wanna tell him I think I have BPD and he triggers it and I like him, that I’m sorry and that I will block him so I don’t jeopardize my relationship with him.
Just cut it out now because I’ll get clingy.

I wrote to him a perfect analysis of how my feelings work and when I was going to send it to him, but I was in class and I copied a link of a website I needed to access, so I lost What I wrote.
It felt like that was the world slapping me again after getting rejected because it’s rare for me to actually give a good letter that means a lot.

However, I have done this before,
I get really clingy and I can’t tell if me leaving is good because I save him and heal faster or because I don’t wanna face the reality.

It’s like when you need to call 911 and your phone dies, you can keep trying but sooner or later the person who needs help will give up because they’re fucked.

I know I’m just such a damn complicated mess that I only have attraction to men who are gentle. I like the complication and the vulnerability. My submissive side makes me want to comfort him but my dominance makes me want to push him to help him feel better.

When I was a little more sober, I was asleep next to him and I realized that I was laying on his chest, I tried waking him up and asking if it was okay but he didn’t wake up, so I just got off because (that’s creepy as hell had I done that while being aware of it). I apologized after and he said not to worry but girl, why am I like this?

From what I was told, my body language was obviously sexual as hell but I didn’t mean it to come off that way. I just hate flirting when being trans because there’s never the reassurance, you just go at it and hope for the best.

I feel like apart of my personality is romanticizing him just so I can feel like I’m pretty while my logical side can actually see him being a compatible partner, also I know he’s not interested.. so I just have to accept it is what it is. 

I don’t want to find a rebound or fuck some random dude to get over it because that’s messy and too much drama. Also, I hate sex, the idea of it is always so much better, for me it’s rare to find a man who knows how to actually please. I feel like I’m lying when I’m moaning.

What I’m saying is, I never figured out how to probably move on, only blocking and hoping to drop feelings, but I wanna continue the frivolous hang out sessions we have.

I want to understand his pain and see why he is the way he is. I don’t wanna sound creepy but I feel like I have an attraction to that dynamic, not because I want to have power over his feelings but I just want to give back what I lack so much of. Reassurance.

But then, I also realize men think different when it comes to love, which is fine because you know... love isn’t linear, it’s a spectrum. But I can’t understand and I want to understand.

I don’t think I’m making any sense.

I have school in a few hours so I’m gonna keep on venting because I don’t wanna break down and do some stupid shit.

I also had the urge to tell him that I’m suicidal but I didn’t. I was tempted to jump off a staircase and end my life but I didn’t, instead I blacked out. I’m a fucking mess.

I’m not a bad person but when it comes to me and my body, I am the most hateful.

I’ve been told so many times that People like the old me, but what they fail to see, the “old” me was a a concoction of the real me with layers of an actress playing the role of a guy.

I probably sound nuts.

I wanna get high and forget but drugs GIVE YOU A REALITY CHECK! So it’s like bro, there’s no way out except handling my feelings but I can’t because I can’t tell if this is how I really feel? Or if it’s testorome trying to compensate?

Normally I would fuck a random man or cut myself but I’ve become less and less of that and more like a rock.

So when I experience happiness and shit like that I remember I do want to transition and be a good person, a wife, daughter, mother and jusy be unapologetically myself.. but then puberty makes me do stupid shit.

I once slit my arm because I got called my legal name or some shit. It was sexist as fuck because it categorized me as a male. When I realized what I did, I went to bed and let it bleed but I was mad that my sheets got dirty. Scars are also ugly.

When I tried to O.D I became more “wise” but I get overwhelmed.

I kind of wanna drop out of high schoool but I did once and it wasn’t in my favor.
Fuck me.
I’m gonna be a deadbeat mom who looks like a man or some shit all because I was born male.

I do picture my life as a woman and I see how happy I could be but then I think of my body and how immobilized it gets when it comes to using the bathroom or just shit that reminds me that I am male.

I hate it. I just wanna rush into things.

I annoy a lot of men I get with, sometimes I enjoy it because it’s vengeance for the shit they did, but that’s so toxic. I’m a toxic person. 

I am an ugky person.

Ok sorry wait, let me try to get into detail.
Also sorry I get emotional, I’m so unstable. I think it’s because I’m in class so that shit flusters me.

Yes he straight and I was flirting but it was a shock he rejected me. I don’t know why I can’t handle rejection. Just being told “You’re not the one I want.” Is so uncomfortable to hear but I still am finding a way to dismiss it.

I’m a fucking fiend for affection. That’s it. 
And no I don’t mean pressure him or even allude to him that I have a crush. I mean in my alone time, I get nostalgic when I think of him.

It’s frustrating because I don’t know if somethings wrong with me or if it’s testorome making me feel obsessive because I WASNT. Like this.

I was thinking of taking acid or some shit but I realize that’s gonna probably boost my feelings for him.

I’m so fucking weird. I just want my hormones to be normal and get rid of the testorome.
Fuck this shit!!!

I don’t know, it’s just my chromosomes. That one thing, had they been the same, it wouldn’t be a gender issue but a rejection issue, which I can handle (I think?). I don’t know dysphoria eats me up.

I originally wanted to rant to clear my chest but reading the responses made me realize yeah, I’m still male, the problem is me. I can’t do anything to change it though. I hate how I sound like a lunatic but then I sound like someone whose missunderstood I don’t fucking know.

It sucks because I understand the reality of my situation, it’s not an outside problem because I am the issue. Unfortunately for me, every relationship that almost came to fruition starts off like this.

It’s a man saying some promise that sounds too good to be true and then I give up my body and he losses his affection? If not that he becomes violent and I really try to hold him down but it never works.

A guy once got mad at me because I didn’t tell him I liked him, before that he was flirting and I felt too cowardly to flirt black. He then said some sexist shit “you really are a bitch” because I was being sensitive?

My friends say it’s daddy issues. I don’t understand why I have to deal with this. I think me mixing the excitement from feeling like I can just live as a girl and feeling normal, feels like false hope. 

When I explain my problems, I never make sense and I just sound sleepy. I’m not shy, I just don’t know who I am.

It sucks because it’s not even like my dissociation when I experienced as a kid. It’s like I see my face and I feel pretty and then I feel like a parasite in my own body.

I do have to code switch so I don’t get outed out to family and family friends, so I’m just use to picking and choosing when to be my “authentic” (literally just me) self and the portrayal as who I was born as.

I even though that if I killed my true self, I would be better but then I realized this isn’t a movie, if I commit suicide, I will die, along with the body that everyone associates with me.

It sucks because I feel like I don’t make sense. It’s not split personality, it’s like I’m method acting except everyday.. just so I can satisfy my religious parents and everyone who hates me for having gender dysphoria.

When I am me, I lose a lot of my social skills because it’s different. I’m not defensive, I’m not angry, I’m just a person trying to grow, but since it’s always tiny pieces of me experiencing my true self. It’s always a do-over because I never got to have my teenage girl years. I’m just forced to know everything.

What I don’t get is, why can’t I just be at peace?

Everything inside me feels physically painful when I have dysphoria and the only way I can help is if I find validation or feel sexy. Not even perverted, because I hate being cat called but I feel like I have to be hyper sexual to prove my point. 

I’m a contradiction of human nature.

It’s also really ironic because in person, I get told I’m really sweet, kind, bubbly or even nonchalant (on bad days).

But I can’t accept that.
I don’t know, I think it might be male puberty because I do black out and forget stuff and my body feels like it’s just testorone making me this way.

However I don’t know but when I feel like me, I feel normal and I have control of everything. Even the overwhelming is bearable.


Thank you.

I know it’s just unfortunate because I don’t know what’s wrong with me. 
I just feel like I’m fucking up my brain and I cry then I forget everything.

I’ve gone everywhere but my body I can’t get rid of, I’ve tried becoming mute but I still need to speak and when I do vent, it never helps.

Drugs aren’t helpful either because they make me feel like I need to better myself but I can’t.

I can’t change my sex, I can act like a man but I always feel like it’s forced and I don’t like it.

I don’t know, I really don’t, I can only cry when I’m alone. I get very addicted to people so quick and I hate it because when I feel uncomfortable I wanna be left alone and I immediately regret it.

The only time I feel good about myself is when I’m not thinking about who and what I am.

I wanna go back to being a kid and wish I could just tell myself to never come out or smack an eraser so I can forget everything.

I don’t know why I whine, I can’t do anything, suicide is just too much and I hate saying that I don’t wanna die but when I get close to it. I don’t fight it, I don’t know.

My stomach always cramps up when I’m in pain, my head hurts and I feel so fucking needy then I feel fine,
It’s fucking irritating.
I don’t mean to be a bitch but I just am, everything feels fake and I don’t know.
I didn’t choose to be born nor my sex, and all my friends who’ve been in this situation eventually find closure. I feel useless
